box_contents.name: CyberBrick Beginner Hardware Kit (1 Car, 1 Remote)

description_blocks.text: Overview

Unleash your creativity with the RC Bulldozer, powered by the CyberBrick ecosystem. The bulldozer features smooth controls, durable tracks, and a functional blade for a realistic pushing and maneuvering experience.

No AMS is required for printing, and all parts fit on the A1 mini! This Bulldozer offers an engaging building experience, culminating in great remote-controlled action. With simplified assembly using the CyberBrick Beginner Hardware Kit, anyone can build and enjoy the fun of this RC Bulldozer!
Find all files and details on its MakerWorld Page.
*For a smooth build, we recommend reviewing the assembly guide first.
Realistic Design & Function
The CyberBrick Bulldozer is not just an RC toy—it's a dynamic platform for creative expression.
As seen in the images, it features a vibrant "Sunflower Yellow" body, customizable lights, controllable ripper attachment, and a fully functional front blade.
Bulldoze whatever you want
Real-World Ready: You can take it outside and interact with gravel and soil. Just like a real-world bulldozer!
Endless Customization: Print gravel or anything else for your own bulldozer. You can find gravel models on its MakerWorld page. Want to try something else? Just search for it on MakerWorld.

More Than a Model: Tired of organizing small items? Let the mini bulldozer help! It can gather your stuff and even retrieve things from tight spots you can't reach. Let it become your handy little helper!
Beginner-Friendly
Officially Verified Design: Both the model and instruction manual are officially tested to ensure successful printing and smooth assembly.
Simplified Assembly: Requires no supports or glue, and uses snap-fit designs to significantly reduce screw usage, saving your printing and assembly time.
Printer-Friendly: All parts are designed for easy 3D printing without requiring an AMS (Automatic Material System) and are optimized to fit on any Bambu Lab printers such as A1 mini.
Charging Tips
If charging is required, unplug the 2-pin cable from the back of the bulldozer and plug it into the charger provided in the kit.
*Important: Ensure the switch module is in the ON position to allow charging.
Remote Control Instruction
The Bulldozer is designed to work with the CyberBrick Official Remote. The creator has uploaded pre-configured settings for immediate play,
while the CyberBrick App allows full customization of controller functions to match your personal preferences.
* Please visit the CyberBrick Official Standard Remote on Makerworld for more details.

Important Notices
To ensure safety, please read and carefully follow the guidelines below. Minors must be under direct adult supervision when using this product.
Intended Users: This product is intended for users aged 16 and above. Users under the age of 16 must be under direct adult supervision throughout use.
Firmware Safety: Please use only official tools for any firmware operations. Flashing with third-party tools is not supported and may cause irreversible damage, which is not covered by warranty.
Operational Safety: Do not touch the moving tracks or wheels while the device is operating to prevent pinching injuries.
Battery & Charging: DO NOT use chargers with output higher than 5V or 2A, only the officially designated battery and charger may be used. Avoid exposing the battery to high temperatures or water.

Maintenance & Storage: Before use, inspect all 3D-printed parts and sand down any sharp edges or burrs if present. Store the model and small parts in a location out of reach of children and pets to prevent choking hazards.
Our company is not liable for any equipment damage, failure, fire, or other loss caused by non-compliance with the above requirements.
Please strictly follow the safety instructions for this product.
